definitions.explanation: Describes a genuine and wholehearted attitude toward something, especially work, study, or interpersonal relationships. Implies deep commitment and lack of pretense.

examples.japanese: {真摯|しんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}け{止|と}める→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{真摯|しんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: He is earnestly committed to his work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{真摯|しんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}け{止|と}め→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧、⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}めます→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: I will take the criticism seriously and work toward improvement.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in formal or written contexts, especially in business and official statements. The adverbial form {真摯|しんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is extremely common, particularly in the set phrase {真摯|しんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}け{止|と}める→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧ (to take something seriously/sincerely).

WRITING:
⟦{真|しん}→真：28884_shin⟧ means "true" and {摯|し} means "earnest." The character {摯|し} is rarely used outside this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真摯|しんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}け{止|と}める→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧: to take seriously
- {真摯|しんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to tackle earnestly
- {真摯|しんし}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a sincere attitude
- {真摯|しんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}き{合|あ}う→向き合う：04652_mukiau⟧: to face sincerely
